name: Trello
tagline: Visual project boards, lists, and cards
description: Trello is a kanban-style project management tool owned by Atlassian. GAIA goes far beyond visual boards to proactively manage your entire digital workflow with AI.
metaTitle: Trello vs GAIA: AI Task Automation
metaDescription: Trello vs GAIA: Trello tracks work you enter by hand; GAIA triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Source-available.
intro: Trello built its reputation on simplicity: drag-and-drop cards across lists on a board. For teams that need a lightweight visual way to track work, it delivers a familiar and frictionless experience. But a board is only as smart as the person moving the cards. GAIA takes a fundamentally different approach — instead of giving you a surface to organize work manually, it acts as a proactive AI assistant that captures tasks from your emails, schedules them against your calendar, automates repetitive workflows, and remembers context across every tool you use. Where Trello shows you what needs doing, GAIA helps get it done.

verdict: Choose Trello if you need a simple, visual board to coordinate a small team's work and want a low-friction tool that everyone can pick up immediately. Choose GAIA if you want an AI assistant that actively manages your tasks, email, calendar, and workflows — reducing the manual overhead of keeping boards up to date and acting on your behalf across the tools you already use.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Trello for project management?
faqs.answer: Yes for most use cases. GAIA manages tasks with priorities, projects, deadlines, and semantic search, and it automatically creates tasks from emails so your list stays current without manual card creation. It also integrates with Trello directly via MCP, so teams still using Trello boards can have GAIA populate and update them automatically.

faqs.question: Does GAIA have kanban-style boards like Trello?
faqs.answer: GAIA focuses on AI-driven task and workflow management rather than visual kanban boards. Tasks are organized by project, priority, and deadline with semantic search. For teams that need visual boards, GAIA can be connected to Trello or other kanban tools via its integrations and keep them updated automatically.

faqs.question: Is GAIA more expensive than Trello?
faqs.answer: GAIA's Pro plan is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month per user, and it can be self-hosted free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs) with full data ownership. Trello's paid plans charge per seat and cost less per person than GAIA. GAIA covers more ground — email management, calendar assistant, automation platform, and task manager — so for some people it replaces several paid tools.

faqs.question: Can GAIA automate Trello workflows?
faqs.answer: Yes. Through its MCP integration layer, GAIA can create cards, move cards between lists, assign members, set due dates, and trigger Trello actions as part of broader multi-step workflows. For example, GAIA can receive an email, create a Trello card from it, assign the right person, and send a Slack notification — all automatically.
